purpose: Record completed local source-context extractions from the C2 long-tail second-batch source extraction queue. This register converts 24 candidate sources into exact claim, endpoint, population, mechanism, uncertainty, transfer-boundary, downgrade and model-position fields while keeping calibrated modeling blocked.

currentLimitations: This is a source-context extraction register, not a complete second-batch Source Card set.
Rows are local source-context extractions and still require independent fresh review before card promotion.
No row admits calibrated prediction, intervention ranking, clinical advice or individual prognosis.

sourceAccessNotes: Publisher, society and government pages may block automated HTTP retrieval; URL accessibility is recorded as source-context metadata and does not itself upgrade or downgrade a scientific claim.
Guideline sources are used as route, endpoint and variable-definition anchors unless later fresh review extracts exact recommendation text, evidence grade, population and comparator.
Directory, program, fact-sheet and publication-route sources are used as lineage, burden, implementation or endpoint-context anchors, not causal-effect anchors.

extractedRows.sourceTitle: ACG Clinical Guideline: Upper Gastrointestinal and Ulcer Bleeding
extractedRows.exactClaimUse: Supports using acute upper gastrointestinal and ulcer bleeding as a time-sensitive hemorrhage continuity domain where risk stratification, resuscitation, transfusion need, endoscopic timing, hemostasis and rebleeding prevention define source-specific route variables.
extractedRows.endpointDefinition: Candidate endpoints include hemodynamic instability, transfusion requirement, time-to-endoscopy, endoscopic hemostasis need, rebleeding, hospital mortality and post-discharge recurrence risk.
extractedRows.populationOrSetting: Adults with overt upper gastrointestinal bleeding or ulcer bleeding in emergency, inpatient gastroenterology and post-discharge care settings. This register does not determine patient-specific management.
extractedRows.effectOrMechanismSignal: Mechanism-level route signal: blood loss and recurrent bleeding change circulating volume, oxygen delivery and mortality risk; resuscitation and definitive hemostasis may alter the acute hazard channel and recovery window.
extractedRows.uncertaintyOrBias: Guideline synthesis depends on bleeding source, severity, comorbidities, anticoagulant exposure, transfusion thresholds, endoscopy access and evidence grade; local endoscopy capacity can change transferability.
extractedRows.transferBoundary: Transfer only to route, endpoint and variable vocabulary. Do not use this source to rank interventions or infer an individual bleeding prognosis.

extractedRows.endpointDefinition: Candidate endpoints include congestion severity, oxygen requirement, renal function change, length of stay, readmission, mortality and transition to guideline-directed long-term therapy.
extractedRows.populationOrSetting: People with heart failure across acute hospital, emergency, inpatient cardiology and follow-up settings, with chronic heart-failure subtype boundaries requiring later card separation.
extractedRows.effectOrMechanismSignal: Mechanism-level route signal: volume overload, impaired cardiac output and neurohormonal activation can shift short-term hazard and functional reserve; discharge transition affects recurrent decompensation risk.
extractedRows.uncertaintyOrBias: Guideline scope spans chronic and acute care; evidence strength differs across HF subtype, renal function, blood pressure, access and comorbidity. Avoid mixing inpatient stabilization with chronic therapy effects.
